title: Could Haaland do it on a cold, rainy night in Stoke?
checked: Stoke relegated from the PL in 2018 and in the Championship in 2026/27; bet365 Stadium (Stoke club page + 2018/19 season page). Haaland joined City in 2022, so he has never played a PL game at Stoke. No official stat for rain or cold exists, so we say so and use comparable games instead: five goals in a 6-2 FA Cup fifth-round win at Kenilworth Road, 27 Feb 2024 (Haaland page + Luton season page; the Haaland page dates it 24 Feb, so only the month is said); 36 PL goals in 2022/23, a PL record; 121 PL goals for City as of Oct 2026 (Haaland page); 9 PL goals in 2026/27 and top scorer (Wikipedia PL table, 2 Nov 2026). Weather at that Luton game not checked, so not claimed.

lines.text: Could Erling Haaland do it on a cold, rainy night in Stoke?
First problem. Stoke went down from the Premier League in twenty eighteen. This season they're in the Championship.

scene.heading: STOKE CITY
scene.body: Relegated from the Premier League in 2018. In the Championship in 2026/27. Home: the bet365 Stadium.

lines.text: Haaland joined City in twenty twenty-two. So he has never played a league game at Stoke.
And nobody keeps an official stat for rain. So we went looking for the closest thing.
February twenty twenty-four. FA Cup. Kenilworth Road, Luton. Tight, old, loud.
Haaland scored five. The first five-goal FA Cup game since George Best in nineteen seventy.
His first Premier League season? Thirty-six league goals. Still the record.
He's at a hundred and twenty-one league goals for City now.
And this season he's top of the scoring chart again, with nine.
Picture it. Stoke back up, Tuesday night, sideways rain, the ball skidding off the turf.
Our prediction? He gets one chance in the six-yard box, and he puts it away.
The verdict: on the evidence, yes. He'd do it on a cold, rainy night in Stoke.
